statement.ru: Слово «бумеранг» пришло из языка индейцев Америки.
statement.en: The word 'boomerang' comes from a Native American language.

why: The word comes from an Australian Aboriginal language.

statement.ru: Панамы так назвали, потому что их плетут в Панаме.
statement.en: Panama hats got their name because they are woven in Panama.

why: Panama hats are traditionally woven in Ecuador; the name came from their sale and wear around Panama.

statement.ru: Английское слово news сложено из первых букв сторон света.
statement.en: The English word 'news' is made from the first letters of the compass points.

why: 'News' is simply the plural of 'new' (Middle English newes, like French nouvelles).

statement.ru: Оранжевый цвет назван в честь апельсина, а не наоборот.
statement.en: The colour orange is named after the fruit, not the other way round.

why: The colour is named after the ripe orange fruit; the word came from Old French pomme d'orange.

statement.ru: Слово «барбекю» — от французского «от бороды до хвоста».
statement.en: The word 'barbecue' comes from the French for 'from beard to tail'.

why: It comes from Spanish barbacoa, from a Taíno word for a wooden frame; 'barbe à queue' is a folk tale.

statement.ru: Слово «пижама» пришло из персидского и значит «одежда для ног».
statement.en: 'Pyjamas' comes from Persian and means 'leg garment'.

why: From Persian pāy 'leg' + jāma 'garment', via Hindustani.

statement.ru: Силуэт назван в честь скупого французского министра финансов.
statement.en: The silhouette is named after a stingy French finance minister.

why: Étienne de Silhouette's penny-pinching made his name stand for cheap things, including cheap cut-out portraits.

statement.ru: «Гиппопотам» по-гречески значит «водяная корова».
statement.en: 'Hippopotamus' is Greek for 'water cow'.

why: The Greek name means 'river horse'.

statement.ru: Смокинг назван в честь пиджака, в котором курили.
statement.en: In many languages a tuxedo is called a 'smoking', after a jacket worn for smoking.

why: In many European languages the dinner jacket is called 'smoking' after the 19th-century smoking jacket.

statement.ru: Слово «катамаран» пришло из древнегреческого.
statement.en: The word 'catamaran' comes from ancient Greek.

why: It comes from the Tamil kattumaram, 'logs bound together', a raft of tree trunks.

statement.ru: Слово «вандал» — это название древнего германского племени.
statement.en: The word 'vandal' is the name of an ancient Germanic tribe.

why: The Vandals, a Germanic people, sacked Rome in 455 and became a byword for destruction.

statement.ru: Слово «картофель» произошло от итальянского названия трюфеля.
statement.en: The German and Russian word for potato comes from the Italian for 'truffle'.

why: German Kartoffel (borrowed into Russian as kartofel) comes from Italian tartufolo, a little truffle.

statement.ru: Слово «свитер» происходит от английского «потеть».
statement.en: The word 'sweater' comes from the English 'to sweat'.

why: Sweater = sweat + -er: a garment that makes you sweat.

statement.ru: Слово «зомби» придумали в Голливуде.
statement.en: The word 'zombie' was invented in Hollywood.

why: The word comes from Haitian folklore (Haitian Creole zonbi, Kikongo zumbi), long before horror films.

statement.ru: Слово «бойкот» — это фамилия управляющего поместьем в Ирландии.
statement.en: The word 'boycott' is the surname of a land agent in Ireland.

why: Captain Charles Boycott, an English land agent in County Mayo, was ostracised in 1880 and gave English the word.

statement.ru: «Шезлонг» по-французски значит «длинный стул».
statement.en: 'Chaise longue' is French for 'long chair'.

why: Chaise longue literally means 'long chair' in French.

statement.ru: «Карате» по-японски значит «удар ногой».
statement.en: 'Karate' is Japanese for 'kick'.

why: Karate means 'empty hand'.

statement.ru: Гольф — это сокращение фразы «только для джентльменов».
statement.en: 'Golf' is short for 'gentlemen only, ladies forbidden'.

why: A backronym myth; the word is first known from Scots golf/gouff, most likely from Dutch kolf, 'club'.

statement.ru: Слово «шоколад» придумали швейцарцы.
statement.en: The word 'chocolate' was coined by the Swiss.

why: Chocolate is a Spanish loanword from Nahuatl, the language of the Aztecs.

statement.ru: Джакузи — это фамилия итальянских братьев.
statement.en: Jacuzzi is the surname of Italian brothers.

why: The company was founded in 1915 by seven Italian immigrant siblings of the Jacuzzi family in California.

statement.ru: «Орангутан» в переводе значит «рыжая обезьяна».
statement.en: 'Orangutan' translates as 'red ape'.

why: From Malay orang 'person' and hutan 'forest': 'person of the forest'.

statement.ru: «Бус» в слове «автобус» — от латинского «для всех».
statement.en: The word 'bus' comes from the Latin for 'for all'.

why: 'Bus' is short for Latin omnibus, 'for all'; avtobus is auto + (omni)bus.

statement.ru: Слово «ресторан» сначала означало подкрепляющий бульон.
statement.en: The word 'restaurant' first meant a restoring broth.

why: From French restaurer, 'restore'; the first Paris restaurants served bouillon said to restore health.

statement.ru: Саксофон назван по фамилии своего изобретателя.
statement.en: The saxophone is named after its inventor.

why: Invented by the Belgian instrument maker Adolphe Sax in the 1840s.

statement.ru: Слово «юмор» сначала означало «смех».
statement.en: The word 'humour' first meant 'laughter'.

why: Latin humor meant a body fluid; the ancient 'humours' were thought to control mood.

statement.ru: Слово «каникулы» происходит от латинского «маленькая собачка».
statement.en: The Russian word for school holidays, 'kanikuly', comes from the Latin for 'little dog'.

why: Canicula, 'little dog', was the Latin name of Sirius; the hot 'dog days' when it rose were a summer break.

statement.ru: Слово «трагедия» по-гречески значит «песнь козла».
statement.en: 'Tragedy' is Greek for 'goat song'.

why: Greek tragōidia, from tragos 'he-goat' and ōidē 'song'; a goat may have been the prize.

statement.ru: Слово «джунгли» пришло из Африки.
statement.en: The word 'jungle' comes from Africa.

why: It comes from Sanskrit jaṅgala via Hindi/Urdu jaṅgal, 'forest'.

statement.ru: Шрапнель назвали в честь города, где её придумали.
statement.en: Shrapnel is named after the town where it was invented.

why: Shrapnel is named after its inventor, the British officer Henry Shrapnel.

statement.ru: Слово «лазер» — это сокращение.
statement.en: The word 'laser' is an abbreviation.

why: Laser began as an acronym of 'light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation'.

statement.ru: Немецкий титул «кайзер» произошёл от имени Цезаря.
statement.en: The German title 'Kaiser' comes from the name Caesar.

why: Kaiser comes from the Roman title Caesar, itself from the family name of Julius Caesar.

statement.ru: Слово «сноб» — сокращение латинского «без знатности».
statement.en: The word 'snob' is short for the Latin 'without nobility'.

why: 'Sine nobilitate' (s.nob.) is a classic false etymology; early uses of 'snob' had nothing to do with it.

statement.ru: Слово «динозавр» значит «древний ящер».
statement.en: The word 'dinosaur' means 'ancient lizard'.

why: Richard Owen coined it in 1842 meaning 'terrible lizard', not 'ancient'.

statement.ru: Никотин назван в честь французского посла.
statement.en: Nicotine is named after a French ambassador.

why: Jean Nicot, French ambassador to Portugal, sent tobacco to Paris; Nicotiana and nicotine are named after him.

statement.ru: «Кимоно» по-японски значит «шёлковое платье».
statement.en: 'Kimono' is Japanese for 'silk dress'.

why: Kimono literally means 'thing to wear' (kiru 'to wear' + mono 'thing').

statement.ru: Слово «тату» пришло из японского языка.
statement.en: The word 'tattoo' comes from Japanese.

why: 'Tattoo' is a loanword from the Samoan tatau, 'to strike'.

statement.ru: Слово «ураган» — это имя древнегреческого бога ветра.
statement.en: The word 'hurricane' is the name of an ancient Greek wind god.

why: It comes via Spanish huracán from a Caribbean (Carib/Taíno) word for a storm god, not from Greek.

statement.ru: Слово «шампунь» пришло из Индии, где так называли массаж головы.
statement.en: The word 'shampoo' comes from India, where it meant a head massage.

why: From Hindi chāmpo, 'to press, knead'; shampoo was a traditional Indian head massage with oils.

statement.ru: Бадминтон назван по фамилии изобретателя игры.
statement.en: Badminton is named after the inventor of the game.

why: It is named after Badminton House, the Duke of Beaufort's estate in Gloucestershire.

statement.ru: Слово «доллар» родом из маленького городка в нынешней Чехии.
statement.en: The word 'dollar' comes from a small town in today's Czech Republic.

why: 'Dollar' comes from the thaler, the Joachimsthaler coin minted in 1519 in Joachimsthal, Bohemia.

statement.ru: Слово «джинсы» произошло от названия итальянского города Генуя.
statement.en: The word 'jeans' comes from the name of the Italian city of Genoa.

why: Gênes, the French name for Genoa, gave the word 'jeans'; the fabric was traded there.

statement.ru: Слово «аллигатор» по-испански значит «большая змея».
statement.en: 'Alligator' comes from the Spanish for 'big snake'.

why: It comes from Spanish el lagarto, 'the lizard', as early settlers in Florida called it.

statement.ru: Лимузин назван по фамилии своего изобретателя.
statement.en: The limousine is named after its inventor.

why: The word comes from the French region of Limousin.

statement.ru: Слово «мускул» происходит от латинского «мышонок».
statement.en: The word 'muscle' comes from the Latin for 'little mouse'.

why: Latin musculus, 'little mouse', because a flexed biceps looks like a mouse's back.
